title: OpenTelemetry Python exporters
versionOrDate: Current OpenTelemetry Python exporter documentation reviewed 2026-08-02; exporter and Collector versions remain deployment-specific
relevance: Official Python examples for OTLP and console exporters, signal pipelines and batched versus simple processing. It supports local source-to-Collector verification and the recommendation to batch normal exports. Example endpoints, container commands and defaults are not a production security or reliability design; bind address, TLS, authentication, timeouts, queueing and compatible pinned versions must be reviewed separately.
